title: Phoenix True Crime Tour: Monsters, Mobsters & Mayhem

blurb:
Step into Phoenix’s most infamous true crime stories—right where they happened.

This fast-paced 1.5-hour walking tour takes you through real locations tied to shocking crimes, courtroom drama, and dark chapters of the city’s past. From historic jails to the courthouse where cases unfolded, you’ll hear the stories that still linger in downtown Phoenix.

This is a locally owned experience built on real research, real history, and the cases that left their mark on the city.
